final_response: Refunds are typically processed within 5–7 business days after approval. The exact timing can vary slightly depending on your card issuer and their processing schedules, but you should see the credit back on your statement within that window. If you don’t see it after a week, feel free to let us know and we’ll investigate further.

events.content: Once a refund gets approved, how many business days does it usually take to land back on my card?

Refunds are typically processed within 5–7 business days after approval. The exact timing can vary slightly depending on your card issuer and their processing schedules, but you should see the credit back on your statement within that window. If you don’t see it after a week, feel free to let us know and we’ll investigate further.
